Graph2Eval: Automatic Multimodal Task Generation for Agents via Knowledge Graphs
	

This repository contains the Graph2Eval-Bench dataset, introduced in the paper Graph2Eval: Automatic Multimodal Task Generation for Agents via Knowledge Graphs.
Graph2Eval-Bench is a curated dataset of 1,319 tasks spanning multimodal document comprehension and web interaction scenarios. reputation: An emerging dataset for multimodal agent evaluation with growing interest among researchers focusing on agent reasoning and web interaction, but not yet widely adopted.
